quark.jei.hint.hoe_harvesting: Hoes can now break a 3 wide area of vegetation at once. Higher tier hoes such as Diamond or Infernite can break 5.
quark.jei.hint.minecraft.lava_bucket: Click an item in your inventory onto the Lava Bucket to destroy it forever! Shulker Boxes and items that are immune to fire such as Infernite can not be destroyed this way.
lore.quark.ender_watcher: A block that emits Flux Power based on how close to the center of the eye a player is looking.
lore.quark.gold_button: A button that gives off a short Flux pulse when pressed.
lore.quark.gravisand: A functional block that only falls when given a flux signal, taking adjacent ones along with it. If it can't fall, it'll float upwards.
lore.quark.iron_button: A button that gives off a long, 5 second Flux pulse when pressed.
lore.quark.chorus_weeds: A natural block that can be found in the barrens of the outer end. Will randomly teleport and reproduce over time or if forced via trampling, bone meal, or adjacent water. May also spawn Othermite when trampled.
lore.quark.pipe: A block that will move items put in with a Hopper/Dropper or equivalent, or via dropped item form on an edge. Items will prefer to fall down, then forwards, then randomly sideways, and only then upwards. Items going into a full container will turn back. Any pipe can be disabled with a Flux signal, and the amount of items in a Pipe can be read with a Comparator. Pipes with over 16 items will break.
lore.quark.magnet: A block that can push and pull any blocks made of Copper or Iron when powered, depending on the side. If multiple magnets are moving the same block, the biggest force will win. A magnet's force on a block is the flux signal it's given minus the distance to the block. Hoppers moved with a Magnet will drop one item in front for each block moved. If the item is a seed, it'll try to plant it instead. Stonecutters moved with a Magnet will try to break the block above them.
lore.quark.obsidian_pressure_plate: A block that emits Flux Power when a player steps on it.
lore.quark.cooked_crab_leg: A Crab Leg that has been cooked, so it heals more than it did raw.
lore.quark.crate: A storage block that holds up to 640 items regardless of their stack size. Not great for bulk storage, but fantastic for tools and a variety of odds and ends.
lore.quark.pickarang: A pickaxe you can throw like a boomerang. It mines whatever it hits and brings the drops back to you.
lore.quark.midori_block: A green decorative block made from Moss Paste.
lore.quark.iron_plate: A sturdy Iron plate. It rusts over time when touching water, unless waxed.
lore.quark.rusty_iron_plate: An Iron plate that has rusted from contact with water.
lore.quark.mud_brick_lattice: A see-through lattice of Mud Bricks.
lore.quark.paper_wall_sakura: A Japanese-style paper wall decorated with cherry blossoms.
lore.quark.paper_lantern_sakura: A Japanese-style paper lantern decorated with cherry blossoms.
lore.quark.glow_shroom_ring: A ring of small Glow Shrooms that grows on cave walls.
lore.quark.glow_shroom_stem: The stem of a giant Glow Shroom.
lore.quark.encased_pipe: A Pipe sealed inside a Copper casing. It moves items just like a Pipe.
lore.quark.egg_parrot_gray: An egg that may hatch a baby Parrot when thrown. Feed a tamed Parrot lots of Beetroot Seeds and it will lay one after about 10 minutes.
entity.quark.crab.description: A passive mob found on beaches. It can be bred with Wheat, Poultry, or any type of Fish. Drops Crab Legs and Crab Shells.
entity.quark.shiba.description: A loyal dog that can be tamed with Bones. If you're holding a Torch, it will point out dark spots for you to light up.
entity.quark.wraith.description: A hostile spirit found in Soul Sand Valleys. Drops Soul Beads, which lead the way to Nether Fortresses.
entity.quark.forgotten.description: A rare, powerful skeleton found deep underground that switches between bow and sword. Drops its Forgotten Hat.
